title: Atabix specialises in the Common Ground forms layer and publishes on choosing open forms
content:
Atabix is a forms-layer specialist in the Dutch Common Ground stack. It works with Open Formulieren and its alternatives, and — more useful for a screen — it publishes on the choice between open-source and partner forms, which puts its reasoning about that trade-off on the record rather than leaving it to be elicited in a first call.

A firm that has already argued publicly about open forms has done part of the qualification work in advance. The offsetting facts are that the forms layer is narrow and the record describes the firm as small, so the realistic engagement is depth in one layer rather than breadth across a municipal stack. It sits at priority 3.
